# MOT7KM Digital Menus

> High-performance digital restaurant menus, interactive catalogs, and QR ordering powered by MOT7KM.

## Core Documentation & Menus
- [MOT7KM Platform](https://mot7km.store): Main platform for store management and digital menus.
- [Digital Menus Portal](https://menu.mot7km.store): Multi-tenant digital menu exploration and ordering.
